messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 Page fired: PD-7482 — inference-queue-error-rate spike in us-west-2. Auto-ack disabled. Details: https://pd.example/PD-7482 • severity: high • potential customer impact: increased 5xxs for online inference.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty alert PD-7482 created and routed to oncall. Escalation policy: inference-oncall.
Priya (oncall): Acked. I'm taking it for now. Quick check: which customers are hitting the queue?
Jamal (customer-succ): Seeing spikes from AcmeCorp and EduBuild via support funnel — both report timeouts ~3-4m. Sharing ticket links in a sec.
Diego (sre): Noted. I see a backlog on the embeddings queue in us-west-2. `kubectl get pods -n inference` looks healthy but `kubectl -n inference logs svc/ingest | tail -n 200` shows repeated `KVCache timeout` errors.
Maya (infra): Infrastructure metrics show instance CPU fine, but GPU mem pressure on pool-g4dn is at 92% for the dedicated fleet. Could be hot partitioning.
Priya (oncall): OK. I'm starting a quick mitigation: switching routing to fallback model variant low-mem. Doing a fastpass handoff to reduce latency. Anyone on bridge?
Avery (eng): I'm free — joining bridge. Need the runbook for model fallback.
Ops Runbook Bot: Runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/inference/fallback-variant • Steps: 1) set routing.override_model=redwood-small-v2 2) monitor 5xx and latency for 15m.
Priya (oncall): Applying override now: `redwoodctl routing set --region us-west-2 --override redwood-small-v2 --reason "auto-fallback PD-7482"`
Priya (oncall): Patch applied. Routing change propagated to 4/5 regions in 30s, last node pending.
Diego (sre): Watching metrics. 5xx count started dropping immediately on the routed traffic path. Latency back to baseline for ~70% of requests. Still seeing tail 5xx from queued jobs.
Maya (infra): I'll spin a replacement node for the hot GPU (g4dn-12xlarge) that's showing degraded nvlink. `aws ec2 replace-spot-fleet-instances` started. ETA ~8min.
Jamal (customer-succ): Notifying AcmeCorp that we're mitigating — they flagged a live demo in 20m. Sending note: "we're routing to fallback model; brief perf impact but requests should succeed"
Priya (oncall): Good. Assigning ownership to Diego for infra recovery and to Priya for customer comms. If no longer needed, will hand back in 30m.
Diego (sre): Claiming ownership for node replacement and cluster health. I'll escalate to infra if replacement fails after 10m.
Avery (eng): Running a targeted cache warm for the fallback model to reduce cold KV misses: `curl -X POST https://internal/loader/warm?model=redwood-small-v2`
Priya (oncall): Quick status ping: PD-7482 impacted ~2.4% of traffic at peak, now down to 0.4%. Customers impacted: AcmeCorp, EduBuild — both notified.
Diego (sre): Node replacement in progress — new instance joined; pod rescheduled. Observability shows GPU memory pressure starting to normalize.
Maya (infra): Confirmed nvlink error logs cleared on replaced host. No error traces in the last 2 mins.
Priya (oncall): Thanks everyone. I'm going to run a short canary to move some traffic back to primary model in 5m. Keep an eye on 5xx and P95.
Avery (eng): Canary started; first ramp to 10% traffic to primary model. Monitoring logs for KVCache timeouts.
Diego (sre): No regression on 5xx so far. P95 slightly higher for the canary slice but within SLO.
Jamal (customer-succ): AcmeCorp says their demo completed successfully. EduBuild reports improved responses.
Priya (oncall): Solid. I'll close PD-7482 once we confirm stability for 20m. For the post-incident: Diego — please take lead on RCA for the gpu partitioning; Maya — include host nvlink telemetry in the timeline; Avery — collect cache warm logs and routing change diffs. I'll draft initial summary for RC meeting.
Diego (sre): Will do. Tentative RCA items: kernel driver nvlink flaps, uneven scheduling causing one GPU to be overloaded, fallback model absorbed load but increased latency for some queued jobs.
Maya (infra): Adding host replacement timestamps and ASG actions to timeline.
Priya (oncall): Closing loop: PD-7482 -> status: mitigated -> next check at 2334508912. Leaving a brief note in incident tracker. Thanks all :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident PD-7482 status changed: mitigated by Priya (oncall) and Diego (sre). Post-incident actions assigned.
Priya (oncall): Final: closing thread here. I'll post the incident writeup in #postmortems after initial RCA."
